tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground: the backing board or table every paper layer sits on.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed directly on background.

tokens.name: ground-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text placed directly on background (eyebrows, meta). Intentional addition: shadcn uses muted-foreground here, but in walnut the ground is dark while paper stays light.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised paper: cards, panels, album pages, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card, popover and secondary.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Top-layer paper: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Deep wood: the one primary action per view, selected states, active tab.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (a raised paper key).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Sunken paper: inputs, tracks, grooves, hover rows, inset panels.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text on card, popover and muted (descriptions, captions, metadata).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlighted item fill inside menus and lists (shadcn meaning, not the brand highlight; that is seal).

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Semantic: error. Delete, remove, failed states; as text on card, muted and destructive-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for error alerts and toasts; destructive text on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Semantic: success. Paid, published, uploaded; as text on card, muted and success-soft. Pair with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for success badges, alerts and toasts; success text on it.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid success fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Semantic: warning (orange). Icon discs, solid badges and ribbons, always with on-warning ink on top and an icon or word beside; the orange edge against paper is about 2.5:1, so it never carries meaning alone. Text in warning goes in warning-text.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for warning badges and alerts; warning text on it.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning as text (deep burnt orange) on card, muted and warning-soft; holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid warning fill (dark ink: the orange is too light for white text).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Semantic: information. Tips, preview mode, neutral notices; as text on card, muted and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for info badges and alerts; info text on it.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid info fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Paper edges, dividers, table rules. Decorative (about 1.4:1): never the only cue that a control exists.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input groove fill; the groove is drawn by shadow-sunken, not a border.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. Meets 3:1 on background and card in parchment and oak; in walnut it is for the dark ground.

tokens.name: ring-paper
tokens.usage: Focus ring for controls sitting on paper (card, popover, muted). Intentional addition so walnut keeps 3:1 on its light paper.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 and the highlighted bar.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 and default bars.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4: slate, the only cool hue, for contrast against the woods.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar paper.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Brand mark tile and primary item in the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: The current item: a raised paper slip.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge and group rules.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: Mid wood: photo corners, chips that are on, slider and progress fills, diorama layers.

tokens.name: on-wood
tokens.usage: Text and icons on wood. Dark in parchment so it holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: primary-edge
tokens.usage: The 3px paper thickness under primary buttons and selected tiles.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Brand highlight: bookmark ribbon, featured badge, the booking call to action. Use once per view.

tokens.name: on-seal
tokens.usage: Text on seal.

tokens.name: print
tokens.usage: Photo print border (the white margin around a photograph).

tokens.name: print-ink
tokens.usage: Handwritten captions written on a print border.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Warm backlight behind diorama layers. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Masking tape strips on taped prints. Decorative.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Dims the page under dialogs, sheets and drawers.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces from Google Fonts, weights 300-600, roman and italic. Italic 300 is the accent voice inside a headline.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. Scale down with clamp(44px, 6vw, 88px).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Closing call to action, section openers.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small headings, sheet and drawer titles (shadcn h4).

styles.name: blockquote
styles.sample: Photograph the cold the way it feels.
styles.usage: Pull quotes, with a 3px wood rule on the left.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans from Google Fonts, 400/500/600. All UI and reading text.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Every image sits inside the page, not on top of it.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page title (shadcn lead), in muted-foreground or ground-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We arrived before sunrise, when the canal still held the night's blue.
styles.usage: Paragraphs (shadcn p). Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, menu items at 15px; buttons use weight 600.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Field labels (600), menu items, table cells (shadcn small).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Descriptions, metadata, helper text (shadcn muted), in muted-foreground.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and section labels. Always uppercase (text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Small and extra-small badges (Badge sm / xs) only. Never for sentences or anything the reader must study.

groups.name: Hand
groups.note: Caveat 500. Only for words written on photographs and pages.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Captions under a feature photo, in print-ink or muted-foreground.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code on a muted chip (shadcn inline code), numbers in tables.

spacing.note: 4px base. Lay out siblings with gap, not margins.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between menu items, icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, between grouped buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside chips and small controls; between form rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Popover padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, gap in component grids.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between related sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Artboard padding, between major sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero and footer breathing room.

radius.note: Paper is cut, not moulded: small radii, round only for pills, dots and avatars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Photos, swatches, keys, tabs inside a strip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, popovers, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Drawer top corners, dialogs on phones.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, switch track, avatars, dots.

shadow.note: Elevation is paper thickness plus a soft cast shadow. Raised 1-3 lift, sunken presses in.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-1
tokens.usage: Level 1, raised paper: cards, panels, items.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-2
tokens.usage: Level 2, a stack of pages: album cards, the open book, the sidebar shell.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-3
tokens.usage: Level 3, the top sheet: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Secondary button and paper keys: an edge plus 3px thickness.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Primary button and selected tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-sunken
tokens.usage: Grooves pressed into paper: inputs, tracks, pressed toggles, wells.

tokens.name: shadow-print
tokens.usage: A loose photo print lying on paper.

tokens.name: shadow-layer
tokens.usage: Diorama layers: cast upward onto the layer behind (use as filter: drop-shadow).

tokens.name: opacity-grain
tokens.usage: Paper grain overlay (feTurbulence noise, mix-blend-mode: multiply) over a whole surface.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

tokens.name: opacity-dim-slide
tokens.usage: Carousel slides that are not current.
